test_title: RRB NTPC UG 2025: शताब्दी शनिवार - Mega Live Test
subject: general
question: After two successive selling, the price of an article increased from Rs. 1800 to Rs. 2277. If the second seller had a profit of 15%, find the profit of the first seller .
solution:
Let the profit of the first seller be ‘x’ %

Hence,

(100 + 15)% of (100 + x)% of 1800 = 2277

⇒ 1.15 × (100 + x) × 18 = 2277

⇒ 18(100 + x) = 2277/1.15

⇒ 1800 + 18x = 1980

⇒ 18x = 180

⇒ x = 10%

∴ The first seller had a profit of 10%
